title: When you need courage
line: Before a hard conversation, an examination, an interview, a first time.
intro: Courage is not the absence of fear; it is moving with it. This practice calls on Hanuman, for whom no task was too great.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Swift as the mind
steps.text: I take refuge in Hanuman, swift as the mind, master of himself.

steps.title: What his remembrance gives
steps.text: Repeat this verse: strength, courage, fearlessness and clear speech come from remembering him.

steps.title: The hard thing
steps.prompt: What exactly am I about to do, and what is the first sentence or the first step?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Go well. Come back afterwards and give thanks, however it went.
